question: Choose the correct one-word substitution for: 'One who lives entirely for pleasure'.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Epicure'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"One who lives entirely for pleasure"** refers to a person devoted to enjoyment and luxurious living. (जो केवल सुख के लिए जीता है)

 
 
• **Example:** He spent his wealth on parties and luxuries, living only for pleasure.
 
 
 
• **"Epicure"** means a person who takes special pleasure in fine food, drink, and luxurious living; someone devoted to enjoyment. (भोग-विलासी / विलासी व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** As an epicure, she always searched for the finest cuisines in every city she visited.
 
 
 
• Thus, **'Epicure'** is the most appropriate one-word substitution.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **Epicure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hermit** (संन्यासी / एकांतवासी): A person who lives alone away from society.

 
 
• **Example:** The hermit lived quietly in a cave in the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Reveler** (आनंद मनाने वाला): A person who enjoys lively festivities.
 
 
• **Example:** The revelers danced all night at the festival.
 
 
 
• **Glutton** (पेटू): A person who eats excessively.
 
 
• **Example:** He was called a glutton because he always overate at parties.
